_readme: Audio-driven presenter clips. Copy to ai/avatar.json, then: node ../../tools/fal/avatar.mjs --project . --dry (then without --dry). omnihuman = bytedance/omnihuman/v2 ($0.105/s, best gestures, output 1284x716, chunks <= 17 s); kling = Kling Avatar v2 Pro ($0.115/s, 1920x1072); heygen = HeyGen Avatar 4 ($0.10/s, 1080p, tighter crop). image = waist-up still with both hands visible; audio = one VO chunk split at a sentence pause. Outputs: ai/clips/<id>.mp4. Every clip is an AI-generated presenter and must be labeled on screen for its whole visible time.
